notes: Not a game. This preset exists to prove the whole pipeline end to end — create a bottle, run a real Windows installer through it, then launch what the installer produced.
It is small, free and quick to install, which makes it the right smoke test before committing to a 50 GB game download.
Rated untested because the installer has not actually been run yet.

hints: Runs the standard 7-Zip Windows installer in silent mode.
